Bill.BriefDescription: Changing the residential property seller disclosure statement.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the residential property seller disclosurestatement; and amending RCW 64.06.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 64.06.020 and 1996 c 301 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
